page_title: CHE 4-0 SOU | Chelsea v Southampton 25/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Thomas Bramall is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+2' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Aaron Ramsdale pulls off a great save to stop his attempt towards the left side of the goal.
90+1' Ryan Manning (Southampton) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Substitution. Enzo Fernandez makes way for Shumaira Mheuka (Chelsea).
89' Substitution. Welington (Southampton) has come on for Yukinari Sugawara.
86' Shots on target – 7:2.
83' Ivan Juric decides to make a substitution. Flynn Downes will be replaced by Cameron Archer (Southampton).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Moises Caicedo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Mathis Amougou (Chelsea).
83' Enzo Maresca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Josh Acheampong (Chelsea) replacing Christopher Nkunku.
81' Ryan Manning (Southampton) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
78' 4 - 0 Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the right side of the goal.
77' William Smallbone (Southampton) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

77' Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Southampton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
76' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Aaron Ramsdale comes off the line to clear the ball away.
76' Chelsea keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
73' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
68' Enzo Maresca prepares a substitution. Pedro Neto is replaced by Tyrique George (Chelsea).
68' It is time for a substitution. Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Chelsea) is on for Jadon Sancho.
66' What was Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
64' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
62' Joe Aribo (Southampton) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
59' Problems for Ivan Juric as Kyle Walker-Peters is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Ryan Manning (Southampton) replaces him.
59' Substitution. Paul Onuachu did his best and is replaced by Tyler Dibling (Southampton).
58' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
56' Chelsea work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
55' A snap shot by Cole Palmer (Chelsea) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Aaron Ramsdale produces a good save to thwart him.
53' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
51' Chelsea have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

50' William Smallbone (Southampton) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
49' Southampton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
49' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
46' Ivan Juric has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) comes on the pitch for James Bree.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' 3 - 0 The ball is whipped in from the resulting set piece and finds Levi Colwill (Chelsea), who rises and produces a crashing header into the middle of the net.
44' Foul! Armel Bella-Kotchap (Southampton) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
43' A cross by Pedro Neto (Chelsea) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
42' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle after Pedro Neto (Chelsea) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
39' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
36' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Christopher Nkunku laid the ball off to Pedro Neto (Chelsea), who shot from close range into the left side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.

32' What a save from Filip Jorgensen! Paul Onuachu (Southampton) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
29' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
29' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is penalised for holding. Thomas Bramall signals a set piece.
27' Flynn Downes (Southampton) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.
24' 1 - 0 Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) finds some space inside the box and scores with a crashing header low into the middle of the net, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
24' Chelsea have a corner.

23' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Cole Palmer (Chelsea) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Aaron Ramsdale pulls off a comfortable save.
22' CHANCE! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the left post.
21' The ball is cleared after Cole Palmer (Chelsea) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
18' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 63:37.
15' A lofted cross from James Bree (Southampton) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

14' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Thomas Bramall blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
14' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
10' A pass by Pedro Neto (Chelsea) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
9' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
7' James Bree (Southampton) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
5' William Smallbone (Southampton) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for an infringement.
3' Chelsea enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
